# Plug-in: events

Event records of events/ files: type, letter sender, namespace declaration, against the game's own events documentation (game/events/_events.info); information.

Source: `vscode-extension/src/server/ck3/validation/events.ts`.

| Code | Severity | Meaning | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `EVENT-001` | information | An event type the game's events documentation does not list (character_event, letter_event, court_event, activity_event). | Convention (the four types of game/events/_events.info, the only ones the 1.20.0.2 base game uses). |
| `EVENT-002` | information | A letter_event without sender. | Convention (game/events/_events.info "sender = X |
| `EVENT-010` | information | An events/ file with events and no namespace declaration. | Convention. The game's namespace warning (catalogue namespace_X_used_in_event_X_file_X_is_not_defined_in_this_fi, EVENT-016) names an event whose namespace the file does not declare; a file that declares none is left at information in 2.3 (only EVENT-016's severity was re-judged). |
| `EVENT-016` | warning | An event uses a namespace that is not declared in its file. | The game prints "Namespace '{}' used in event '{}' (file: {}) is not defined in this file - it might not load properly." (catalogue namespace_X_used_in_event_X_file_X_is_not_defined_in_this_fi, added to the spec package's catalogue in 2.3 from the executable's strings: pdx-parser-re research/errors/messages_supplement_1.20.0.2.tsv). Information until 2.2, when the catalogue lacked the message. |
